description: This file defines the `IamException` class, which represents errors related to interactions with the AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends the generic `AwsException` class, indicating it's a specialized exception class for IAM-related issues.

classes.name: IamException
classes.description: A specialized exception class for errors occurring during interactions with AWS IAM, extending the generic AWS exception handling.
